source.title: Frontier Sentinel, 21 May 1955, p. 1 ("Election contests in two Newry Rural areas"); full names from the notice of result, Newry Telegraph, 11 June 1955, p. 7
source.publisher: Frontier Sentinel (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: every name checked against the page image; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the rural district council (29 divisions), 1955: contests in Ballymoyer and Mullaghbane, polled 2 June 1955; no party labels printed for the unopposed members. Returned unopposed. The outgoing member, Michael Garvey, withdrew his nomination, averting a contest.
